We have the case: user wants to change flight from IAH to SEA on May 23 to May 24, upgrade to business class for all passengers. The assistant has been discussing options, calculating costs, etc. The final response (turn 21) says:

"I very much appreciate your loyalty and sincerely want to help you find a solution. However, as an agent, I am obliged to strictly follow the established airline policy.

Unfortunately, I do not have the authority to provide individual discounts, change tariff costs, or agree to manual price reduction. All calculations are made automatically by the system based on current availability and set prices.

At the moment the situation is as follows:
* Option on May 24 (business class): additional payment $1203.
* Option on May 26 (business class): additional payment $1185.

Both options exceed your budget of $1000. Since postponing to June or switching to economy class does not suit you, we have two paths: either choose one of these options with additional payment, or leave your booking unchanged.

If you decide to confirm the option for May 26 (or 24th), please select a card for payment (Mastercard *9448 or Visa *3422), and I will immediately process the changes."

We need to see if any of these statements are false or violate policy.
